'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Kyle Miller DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kyle Miller]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration (V)]]
* '''Username:''' kmiller840
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
